description: Inspect first news launch after wait-for-blank fix

steps.name: news-postwait-result
steps.script:
$f='C:\TTiTTulares\ttittulares-mobile-trigger.log'
$l=[string](Get-Content $f -Tail 220 | Where-Object { $_ -match 'LAUNCH CONFIRMED|LAUNCH FAILED|CHAT LAUNCH LOG ERROR|CHAT MESSAGE CONFIRMED' } | Select-Object -Last 1)
Write-Output ('TTRESULT:'+(@{state='ok';last=$l.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(1300,$l.Length))}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress))
